specification.objective: Make the backlog and Kanban top action areas visually consistent while preserving their distinct controls and responsive behavior.

requirements.statement: Backlog and Kanban action areas use one shared toolbar surface with the same surface color, outline, and 12-pixel padding.
Interactive controls in both action areas align to a 48-logical-pixel minimum height while retaining existing labels, callbacks, permission checks, and behavior.
The project selector, view switch, metrics strip, and refresh control in the shared project overview align to the same 52-logical-pixel height.

acceptance_criteria.statement: The backlog and Kanban each render exactly one shared toolbar surface with the same border, surface, and padding tokens.
Backlog search, filters, and actions plus Kanban navigation and column creation controls are at least 48 logical pixels high and remain usable at wide and narrow viewports.
The shared project overview selector, view switch, metrics strip, and refresh control are each 52 logical pixels high.
docs/contracts/workspace-toolbar-consistency-v2.polis.json is byte-for-byte identical to the locked contract.

invariants.statement: Preserve the existing project selector, view switch, metrics, refresh control, filter options, content, routing, callbacks, permissions, loading state, and persistence.
Keep narrow layouts horizontally usable without layout exceptions and do not reduce any interactive target below 48 by 48 logical pixels.

forbidden_states.statement: Backlog and Kanban action areas use mismatched surface, border, padding, or control heights.
The responsive toolbar clips actions, introduces a layout exception, or changes existing behavior or authorization.

inputs.statement: Backlog and Kanban viewport constraints, project board data, and existing permission/state flags.

outputs.statement: Consistently styled, accessible, responsive action areas for backlog and Kanban.

failure_semantics.statement: Flutter widget tests fail with the workspace_overview_control_height or workspace_toolbar_shared_surface marker when the contract is violated.

argv: kanban toolbar shares the surface and 48-pixel control height
